question.text: ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) is best described as:

answer.text: An equity mutual fund / tax-saving fund with tax benefits under Section 80C
A scheme with no tax benefit
A scheme subject to double taxation

explanation.text: The Logic: The source workbook describes ELSS as an equity mutual fund / tax-saving fund whose investors are eligible for tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, which is what the cited pages support. The Trap: The other options each contradict the source by denying the Section 80C benefit, mis-classifying ELSS as debt-only, or inventing a double-taxation feature. Note: Only the ELSS-as-equity-tax-saver and Section 80C eligibility are anchored to the page checked; the specific lock-in length, old-regime qualification, and Rs. 1.5 lakh limit require a separately cited source.
